scope: Radio serial stories in the Tzivos Hashem radio program (series uy_tzivos_hashem_on_the_air). Values reflect items/ after pass2/serials.json is applied.

fields.runs: One entry per airing of the serial. Chapter numbers follow the full telling, so a re-run that starts mid-story keeps the story chapter numbers.
fields.segment_start_sec: Start of the first story-chapter segment for this chapter in that episode file; parts lists every piece when the chapter is split by other segments.
fields.intro_start_sec: Start of the story intro / recap segment that leads into the chapter, when there is one.
fields.same_text_as_earlier_run: Earlier runs whose chapter segments match this run at >= 0.85 transcript containment for at least half of the chapters both runs have: the same script, usually the same recording re-aired (text alone cannot prove it is the same audio).
fields.text_matches_in_other_runs: Transcript 6-gram containment between this chapter segment and chapter segments of other runs (>= 0.6).
fields.catalog_only_runs: Airings known only from the master catalog (audio not in the archive): for the lost-episodes list.
fields.other_airings_text_match: Non-serial radio episodes whose story segment matches a chapter at >= 0.8: the story told complete in one episode or a chapter re-aired. Unverified leads for the same-story / aired_again_in tasks.
